headline: Autumn forecast - European Commission also sees recession in Romania - Revision from stagnation to slight economic contraction - Inflation holds up
summary: The European Commission revised its 2026 forecast for Romania from stagnation to economic contraction. Inflation is also holding up, according to the autumn forecast.
why: The European Commission's forecasts shape expectations for EU member economies, budget planning and investor views on regional growth.
